title: Your groups
lede: Every group you are a member of. A group is who people promise to and who settles with whom - the plan inside it is the one that nets everybody's commitments against each other.
signedOut: Sign in to see the groups you belong to.

list.title: Your groups
list.description: Most recently joined first, so the group you just made is at the top.
list.empty: You are not in any group yet. Making one below is how the first one happens.

create.title: Make a group
create.description: A name and what it settles in. You are its first member, and its admin. The settlement zone is left unset on purpose: it decides which cycle a commitment falls in, so a group chooses it deliberately rather than inheriting somebody else's timezone.
create.name: Name

open.title: Join a group with a code
open.description: A group hands out a code that lets somebody join it. It is eight characters, it lasts seven days, and whoever holds it can use it - which is why a group sends it to somebody it trusts rather than posting it. This takes you to the page that says which group it is for before you join.
